analysis_goal: understand at a high level how the system works, identify the main types of users and their main goals, and see how functionalities are related

analysis_tasks.goal: Identify the general architectural layout and high-level workflow of the system for reporting and managing problems in a municipal area
expected_evidence: Components and workflow related to report review and system architecture

analysis_tasks.goal: Identify the main types of users that interact with the system for reporting and managing problems in a municipal area
expected_evidence: User types, roles, and entities interacting with the system

analysis_tasks.goal: Identify the primary goals and functionalities that the system provides to its users
expected_evidence: Primary functionalities and user goals supported by the boundaries and controllers

analysis_tasks.goal: Determine how the different functionalities and user goals are related to each other within the system
expected_evidence: Dependencies and relationships between user functionalities and goals

constraints: do not yet know the specific user roles
do not yet know the functionalities available to each of them
do not: inventing decisions not in the repo
inventing decisions not in the repo
